verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents magic-link email sign-in with no API key required by default, and self-renewing sessions, so the 'sign in without managing keys' part is clearly delivered. The free tier is only implied: there are plans, usage windows and automatic upgrades, but no free plan is explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a free tier and its limits, independent/hands-on corroboration of keyless sign-in.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: ByteAsk uses **magic-link email sign-in** - no API key required by default.
Shows your current plan and how much of each usage window you've spent.
Your plan is upgraded automatically once payment completes - no need to sign in again.
Your session now renews itself quietly at launch, well before it expires.
